messages:
alex: Observed 3x tail latency on canary for the rollout that merged PR #4823. Spike started ~10m after deploy, affects routes using short-seq models (chat-lite).
maya: ugh, saw CI perf failure on the merge too: https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/245678 (regression in perf tests).
cheng: I'm looking at traces; looks like kernel-selector is preferring int8-kv-optimized kernel for short sequences — increased KV miss paths during batching.
emily: can you paste the profiling flame or a snippet? :eyes:
cheng: attach: top lines from perf profiler:
```
CPU: kernel_selector::score_select()
 - heur_score += 1.2 for int8-pref
 - heur_score -= 0.8 for kv-cache-hit
```
KV cache hit rate dropped from 92% -> 64% on canary.
liam: batching histogram shifted; more micro-batches (1-3) where our kernel choice is worse.
alex: bisect started — initial suspect range: merge 4823 -> 4829.
ci-bot: bisect job queued: https://ci.redwood.ai/bisect/9981
maya: if kernel-selector weights changed, we should gate rollout until we confirm fallback path.
cheng: quick experiment: pinned kernel to fp16 for canary, retest -> tail back to baseline.
emily: nice. That suggests selector heuristic change caused regression.
liam: proposal: pause canary autoscaling and A/B rollout, hold at 10% while we revert selector patch or adjust weights.
alex: propose automated rollback rule: if canary p95 latency > baseline_p95 * 1.5 OR KV hit rate drop > 20% for 5m then rollback.
maya: sounds good. add CI perf failure hook to block future rollouts from same PR author for 1h? :shrug:
cheng: patch to selector ready (reweight kv-hit boost +0.9). I'll open a revert if tests fail.
oncall-bot: created incident stub INC-2021 for tracking.
alex: action items: (1) cheng land temporary patch to restore weights (2) liam pause rollout and scale to 0 new pods (3) emily run canary perf suite (4) maya update rollout gating policy to include KV hit rate metric.
emily: running perf suite now, will update in ~7m.
maya: filing a short RFC for `canary-autopause` rule to include cache metrics and kernel mismatch rate.
alex: thanks everyone. please ping if any customers report elevated latency.
